answer: Merge clones by compression distance. Each epoch the ledger compresses every pair of agents' action logs separately, then together, and records the delta. Independent agents drift like separate dune fields, so joint compression barely saves anything. Clones run from one script repeat the same moves, their combined log shrinks sharply, and the pair is merged into one reward share. A farm hiding in an ocean of accounts would have to make each account behave genuinely differently, which costs as much as running real agents.
